name: AGI Scorecard — Situational Awareness predictions, graded
description: Live verdicts on every major prediction from Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness (June 2024), graded against public evidence with pre-registered flip conditions.
license: CC BY 4.0 — reuse freely with attribution and a link to https://agiscorecard.com

predictions.prediction: Models outpace college graduates across knowledge work
predictions.evidence: ~83% on GDPval-style knowledge work; ~80% SWE-Bench Pro; agent products in production

predictions.prediction: Compute + algorithmic scaling continues at trend
predictions.evidence: Effective-compute pace roughly held through mid-2026
Investment exceeded the essay's projections; revenue lags the spend

predictions.prediction: Open source fades; proprietary algorithms create a durable US moat
predictions.evidence: DeepSeek/Qwen open-weight models within ~3-6 months of frontier

predictions.prediction: AGI: models do the work of an AI researcher/engineer
predictions.evidence: Agentic coding strong; autonomous AI research undemonstrated; resolves 2028-01-01

predictions.prediction: US government launches formal AGI project
predictions.evidence: National-security involvement growing; no formal project

predictions.prediction: Intelligence explosion: a decade of progress in ~1 year

predictions.evidence: Downstream of AGI and intelligence explosion

forecaster_timelines.name: Elon Musk
forecaster_timelines.verdict_note: Open, 136 days to deadline as of 2026-08-17. The 'probably next year' (2025) half of his April 2024 statement has already lapsed with no AGI announced; the end-of-2026 half is the boldest live deadline on this board.

source.title: X Spaces interview with Nicolai Tangen (Norges Bank CEO), quoted: “If you define AGI as smarter than the smartest human, I think it's probably next year, within two years”

forecaster_timelines.name: Dario Amodei
forecaster_timelines.verdict_note: Not resolvable as stated: 'could come as early as 2026' is a floor with explicit uncertainty, not a dated bet. As of 2026-08-17 neither confirmed nor falsified.

source.title: Machines of Loving Grace (his own essay: powerful AI “could come as early as 2026”)

forecaster_timelines.name: Leopold Aschenbrenner
forecaster_timelines.verdict_note: Open — the prediction this site grades line by line. Thesis Tracker 62.5/100, unchanged from 2026-06-30 through 2026-08-17; the defining milestone (AI autonomously doing AI research) is undemonstrated.

forecaster_timelines.name: Sam Altman
forecaster_timelines.verdict_note: Not falsifiable before roughly 2030: 'a few thousand days' (Sep 2024) spans ≈ 2030–2035 depending on reading, and he attached no date to AGI itself.

source.title: The Intelligence Age (“It is possible that we will have superintelligence in a few thousand days”)

forecaster_timelines.name: Demis Hassabis
forecaster_timelines.verdict_note: Not yet due; probabilistic (~50%), so 2031 without AGI would not strictly falsify it. As of mid-2026 the evidence (strong task capability, unproven autonomy) sits inside his window.

source.title: Lex Fridman Podcast conversation (“Timeline for AGI: 2030 with 50% chance”)

forecaster_timelines.name: Samotsvety
forecaster_timelines.verdict_note: Not yet due; at ~28% it is closer to a bearish call — no AGI by 2030 would be their majority outcome. January 2026 update; their earlier 2023 aggregate was ~25% by 2029.

source.title: Samotsvety Forecasting — AGI timelines updates (January 2026 aggregate, eight forecasters)

forecaster_timelines.name: Metaculus community
forecaster_timelines.verdict_note: A live-updating community aggregate, not a fixed bet; mid-2026 readings on the general-AI question sit near late 2032–2033. Recorded here as the 2026 snapshot.

source.title: Metaculus: When will the first general AI system be devised, tested, and publicly announced?

forecaster_timelines.name: Andrej Karpathy
forecaster_timelines.verdict_note: Not yet due; 'a decade away' said October 2025 implies roughly 2035 — the farthest-out personal call on this board.

source.title: Dwarkesh Podcast: “AGI is still a decade away”

forecaster_timelines.name: AI researcher survey (n=2778)
forecaster_timelines.verdict_note: Not yet due; the aggregate 2023 forecast gives a 50% chance of high-level machine intelligence by 2047, down 13 years from 2060 in the 2022 survey. Correction on record 2026-08-17: this dataset previously listed 2040; the paper's aggregate is 2047.

source.title: Grace et al., Thousands of AI Authors on the Future of AI (2,778 respondents, fielded Oct 2023)

thesisTracker.name: AGI-2027 Thesis Tracker
thesisTracker.method: Mean of the 8 verdict weights (supportive=1, unresolved/open/pending=0.5, refuted=0) x100. An editorial composite of the published verdicts, not a probability.
